name: Slow Eccentric EZ Bar Skull Crusher
validation_note: Bands are the standard coaching ranges for this movement, not measured against a labelled clip. Treat a fix verdict as a prompt to look, not as a measured fault.

start_cue.en: Set your elbow still, then straighten your arm.
start_cue.hi: Kohni sthir rakho, phir haath seedha karo.

good.en: Good. You straightened your arms fully.
good.hi: Badhiya. Aapne haath poore seedhe kiye.

fix.en: Straighten your arms all the way.

below.en: Do not hyperextend. Stop when the arm is straight.
below.hi: Seedhe se zyada nahi. Seedha hote hi ruko.

almost.en: Straighten your arms all the way.

good.en: Good. You let the elbow close fully.

fix.en: Let the elbow close all the way so the muscle stretches.
fix.hi: Kohni poora band hone do taaki muscle stretch ho.

almost.en: Let the elbow close all the way so the muscle stretches.
almost.hi: Kohni poora band hone do taaki muscle stretch ho.

fix.en: You are leaning into it. Keep your body still.
fix.hi: Aap shareer se dhakel rahe hain. Shareer sthir rakho.

almost.en: You are leaning into it. Keep your body still.
almost.hi: Aap shareer se dhakel rahe hain. Shareer sthir rakho.

fix.en: Too fast. Control the return. Count 2 seconds.
fix.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

below.en: Too fast. Control the return. Count 2 seconds.
below.hi: Bahut tez hai. Wapas aane mein control rakho. 2 tak gino.

almost.en: A bit fast. Count 2 seconds on the way down.
almost.hi: Thoda tez hai. Neeche aate time 2 tak gino.
